storage_policy: Do not commit multi-gigabyte corpora to Git history. Keep immutable manifests, source revisions, checksums and curation reports in Git; keep bulk data in an explicitly configured object store or dataset host. GitHub Actions runners/artifacts are for bounded staging and audit, not permanent 500 GB storage.

research_notes.note: Additional external sources discovered: OpenThoughts3-1.2M (Apache-2.0 declared, 1.2M train rows, source lineage still to audit); Aya (Apache-2.0 declared, 204k multilingual human annotations, privacy/splits to audit); Dolma and FineWeb (ODC-BY database license, underlying source rights remain); DCLM (CC-BY-4.0 declared, source terms and research-use conditions to audit). All remain candidates and contribute zero admitted bytes until payload, rights, split, provenance, hashes, dedup and holdout gates pass.
